title: Apollo 11 post-flight press conference looks deceptive
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Apollo 11 post-flight press conference looks deceptive, about 1969 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Watch the Apollo 11 postflight press conference. Watch it. It's like a hostage video.

plain: A popular podcast host, Joe Rogan, urges people to watch the press conference the Apollo 11 astronauts gave after returning from the first Moon landing in 1969. He says it looks like a hostage video, and he cites an unnamed body language expert who reads the astronauts as hiding something, which would mean the public was not told everything about the trip.
